method.sparse_checkout_handling: Enumerated HEAD with git ls-tree -r --name-only; read local hydrated files, with git show HEAD:path fallback for sparse files. Local absence is not treated as repository absence.
method.absence_scope: Tracked species/name paths, group design/Bible/asset records/manifests and actual script literals examined; not an assertion that all anonymous image pixels in repository were semantically classified.
method.quality_boundary: No visual quality verdict. User rejection of prior overall quality remains the latest acceptance fact. Mesh deformation is an implementation method, not automatically good or bad.

facts: All 9 actual stable IDs take the generic accepted EnemyHitTemplate branch, not the authored charger/diver H/D frame profile.
Shared contact fan/chips are procedural polygons/rects/lines. Shared body flash/pose sample is not a species-specific hurt sprite sequence.
Current forest actions and death use the same one-body image; prototype posed art is retained but only canonical neutral crops are live.

shared_audio.default_and_selection: GameAudio starts original; actual audio-director selection/overrides are dynamic. No listening or player-specific saved selection measured.
shared_audio.dedicated_banks: No separate hurt/death voice bank per these 9 species found in their actual consumers. forest_web is shared regional state-entry sound; Seed bell/shoot and prototype armour use shared cues. Bark shield_contact has a visual-only presentation subscriber; no direct shield_contact audio subscriber found in tracked scripts.
facts: EnemyAttackBehavior._set_state telegraph uses the shared warning cue, including forest/candidate subclasses that enter telegraph.
No unique species hurt/death recording was found through the nine actual consumer branches; this does not classify every anonymous audio file in the repository.

manifest_warning: family manifest native v1 direct_sampling=true is retained metadata, while current ForestBibleActors directly preloads fine_32 for five bodies. Do not equate manifest registration/status with current executed texture or user approval.

evidence.excerpt: 当前基底是铃囊萤、棘籽哨、旧 charger 森林配方与织棘蛛。新版 v9 在地图2的一个共享庭院分支加入真实跨枝移动体与同一宝箱的异路回程；它提供可选运动表达，**不主张比普通强解更快、更省，或已经完成整区生态丰富度**。折枝獾、旧同轴停驻者、上层 Seed＋Lamp 和侧环 HR 均已淘汰，不能用新 ID 或技术通过给它们翻案。
